title: Retry 3d47: replay refusal-rule changes over 50 past readings
summary: Retry of job 20261028-103330-3d47, which failed only because the agent OAuth token expired (401) before the producer did any work; that is an environment stop, not a finding on the work, so the work is the same as its accepted reading. Add an `athena check-reading` subcommand and replay the newest 50 accepted readings through base and candidate builds. Store the result as a typed record, show it to the verifier, and hold the job if over 10% are newly refused. Audience: maintainers and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: Tests per module plus fmt, clippy -D warnings and cargo test criteria.
Criteria name the cargo test commands that exercise the behavior.
Criteria check refusals listed and held, not just that code exists.
Credential preflight left out as a separate job.
Prior failure was an environment stop (expired token), not a work defect, so the work is unchanged.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 20261028-103330-3d47 ended with no verification; its single recorded outcome was the 401 expired token, so no code finding needs fixing. Its discarded changes start again from the base.

The introspection's proposed credential preflight and 401 environment-stop work is a separate job; this retry does only the replay work, as the typed request says. If the token is still expired, the retry will fail the same way.
Same design as the accepted reading: replay is run by the `athena check-reading` subcommand from base and candidate builds, every candidate gets it, and there is no flag detection and no replay.md.

The 10% threshold is a code constant. The override in tests sits in front of tree resolution and the subcommand probe. No-model-call is shown by comparing model call counts with and without a candidate rule change.

acceptance_criteria.text: `athena check-reading` takes a stored request and reading and prints accept or refuse with the reason, using the reading.rs rules; a fixture test shows both outputs (cargo test -p athena-cli).
A test builds a candidate-like rule change over fixture records and lists the newly refused requests (refused by candidate, accepted by base) with the count (cargo test -p athena-core).
A test shows the replay uses only the newest 50 requests with accepted readings, and that an empty history gives 'no replay: <reason>', not a pass (cargo test -p athena-core).

A test shows more than 10% newly refused is held with the list, exactly 10% or less is not held, and a candidate whose criteria intend a higher rate is not held, with the replay still recorded (cargo test -p athena-core).

A pipeline test, with the override in front of tree resolution and the subcommand probe, shows a candidate over the threshold is Rejected, not landed; the typed replay record and the Athena Blocker finding name the list, the records check accepts the job directory, and no replay.md is created (cargo test -p athena-core).
The typed replay field or record kind has a schema round-trip test and passes the records check (cargo test -p athena-data).
A pipeline test shows model call counts are equal for a run with a candidate rule change and one without, so the replay makes no model call (cargo test -p athena-core).

A test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs shows the verifier brief carries the replay summary (newly refused count, total, list) or 'no replay: <reason>', and stays within its size limit with a very long list (cargo test -p athena-context).
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the subcommand, the replay, the 10% hold, the typed record and the verifier brief summary.

git diff shows no change to athena.toml, defaults.toml or .github/workflows; the 10% threshold is a code constant; no existing reading rule changed; no replay.md is written and no skip switch is added.

out_of_scope: Detecting refusal-rule changes by a flag or by matching diffs
Creating a free-form replay.md in the job directory
Adding a switch to skip the replay
Automatic disk cleanup or disk reservation before the verifier
Credential preflight and 401 environment-stop handling (separate job from the introspection)
departures: Larger than the reference: the change spans eight files, a new subcommand and a typed record, and the same work failed to complete twice before.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time from failed attempts: two earlier attempts of this work ended in environment stops, and the replay guards against refusal rules that stopped drains.
hard_reason: Adds a rule that can hold work (the 10% replay hold) and changes the run pipeline and the gate that judges other jobs, so a mistake is costly.
